title: LWC Design System
summary: A small library of accessible Lightning Web Components with a consistent visual language.
description: An open-source LWC component kit focused on accessibility and theming. Includes buttons, modals, tables, and data-bound primitives. Documented with live examples and unit-tested.

title: Service Cloud Revamp
summary: Re-architected a high-volume case management workflow, reducing handle time by 28%.
description: Led the redesign of a client's Service Cloud implementation: modernized Flows, replaced legacy triggers with handler patterns, and rolled out an LWC console for agents.

title: Integration Platform

description: Designed a Platform Events + Named Credentials based pipeline with retry, dead-letter, and observability. Improved reliability and removed brittle point-to-point integrations.

title: Portfolio v2
